text: 1. Citizens of Laos, Vietnam, Russia, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Kazakhstan, and Uzbekistan are in good health;2. Educational and age requirements:Applicants for a master's degree in China must hold a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35;Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be under the age of 40.Applicants under the age of 18 must submit relevant legal documents of their legal guardian in China.Applicants are not allowed to enjoy other scholarships (excluding one-time scholarships) established by Chinese governments at all levels and admission institutions at the same time when applying. Once discovered, their application eligibility will be cancelled.
